title: Creeper
summary: A hostile mob that silently approaches players and explodes when close.

title: Blaze
summary: A fiery hostile mob found in Nether fortresses and the only source of blaze rods.

title: Diamond Pickaxe
summary: A high-tier pickaxe crafted from diamonds and sticks.

title: Crafting Table
summary: A utility block that unlocks the full crafting grid.

title: The Nether
summary: A dangerous volcanic fungal dimension with lava seas, unique biomes, and hostile mobs.

title: Nether Fortress
summary: A large Nether structure made of Nether bricks with bridges, corridors, and towers.
